en.headline: Fairview Park house burgled; jewellery worth about $300,000 taken
en.dek: A 49-year-old man reported two rings and a jade bracelet missing from a detached house on Bauhinia South Road late on Saturday; police classified the case as burglary.
body: Yuen Long police are investigating a burglary at a detached house in Fairview Park after a 49-year-old resident reported late on Saturday that jewellery had been taken from the property.

Officers were called to Bauhinia South Road at about 11.43pm. After a preliminary count, police said two rings worth about HK$100,000 and a jade bracelet worth about HK$200,000 were missing, for a total of about HK$300,000.
The case has been classified as burglary and assigned to Yuen Long District Crime Squad 9. No arrest had been announced by Sunday morning.

zh.headline: 元朗錦緣花園獨立屋遇竊 失約30萬元戒指玉鑛
zh.dek: 一名49歲男子周六深夜報稱紫荊南路獨立屋失竊，警方初步點算兩隻戒指及一隻玉鑛失蹤，暫未有人被捕。
body: 元朗警區正調查錦緣花園一宗爆竊案。一名49歲男子周六晚約11時43分報稱，其紫荊南路獨立屋懷疑遭人入屋搜揮。
警員到場後初步點算，相信失去兩隻合共約值10萬元的戒指，以及一隻約值20萬元的玉鑛，總值約30萬元。
案件列作爆竊，交由元朗警區刑事調查隊第九隊跟進，至周日早上暫未有人被捕。
